scenario: Eight interns — Farida, Guo, Holt, Ines, Jarvis, Kapoor, Lund, and Mercer — are each assigned to exactly one of three hospital departments: Cardiology, Neurology, and Oncology. Cardiology receives exactly three interns, Neurology receives exactly three interns, and Oncology receives exactly two interns. The following conditions apply:

rules.description: Guo and Holt are not assigned to the same department.
If Ines is assigned to Neurology, then Kapoor is assigned to Oncology.
If Jarvis is assigned to Oncology, then Lund is assigned to Oncology.
Kapoor and Mercer are not assigned to the same department.
Guo is not assigned to Oncology.
